codcaster/3rd_person_camera_follow_mode_:
^%Fixed^7: The camera remains behind the spectated player's operator.

^%Orbital^7: The camera is tethered at a specific distance from the operator and the Codcaster is able to move the camera around them.
codcaster/aerial_camera_default_desc:
Set the Aerial Camera's mode on used on map start.

^%Follow^7: The camera is tethered to the spectated player and the observer can offset the camera position around this player.

^%Free^7: The observer fully controls the Aerial Camera's position.
codcaster/aerial_camera_movement_smoothi:
^%Low Value^7: Aerial Camera movement is smoother with extra movement added to the observer's inputs, resulting in more progressive accelerations and decelerations.

^%High Value^7: Aerial Camera movement is sharper and reflects the observer's movement inputs more closely.
codcaster/aerial_camera_movement_speed_d: Adjust the speed of the Aerial Camera's movement.
codcaster/aerial_camera_pucks_enabled_de:
Display an arrow VFX under players while using the ^%Aerial Camera^7.

Pucks are visible through walls and increase visibility while spectating.
codcaster/aerial_camera_rotation_speed_d: Adjust the speed at which the Aerial Camera rotates 90 degrees.
codcaster/aerial_camera_transition_time_: Set the amount of time required to switch to the Aerial Camera.
codcaster/aerial_camera_vertical_movemen:
^%Low Value^7: Aerial Camera zoom is smoother with extra movement added to the observer's inputs, resulting in more progressive accelerations and decelerations.

^%High Value^7: Aerial Camera zoom is sharper and reflects the observer's movement inputs more closely.
Adjust the speed of the Aerial Camera's zoom.

LIST OF COLLECTED PERSONAL DATA AND COLLECTION METHOD

Activision Publishing, Inc. Even when you do not enter personal data that is optional, there is no limitation on your use of our services. Perform the services, and personalizing your experience on our Properties
Commercial purposes, such as facilitating purchases of Activision products or service, or sending newsletters, marketing, surveys, and to provide you with targeted advertising
Facilitate purchases of Activision products or services
Interact with Customer Service
Detect security incidents and secure our Properties
Undertaking activities to verify and maintain the quality of our service, such as preventing cheating and bad behavior

hash_1d1b0a98f1aff4c6: Officer Ranks are specific to the current Season. Climb as high as possible during the current season to maximize your Rank. Remember - Officer Ranks are reset at the start of each new Season, but your achievements will be saved to build your history as a combatant.
hash_f55031b5562dd2c: Field Upgrades are abilities and pieces of gear that can give you a tactical edge in battle.
hash_f55061b5562e245: They recharge throughout a fight. More powerful Field Upgrades take longer to charge.
hash_f55051b5562e092: Field Upgrade Pro lets you equip two Field Upgrades instead of one. Choose between them on each activation. Unlocked at level 45.
hash_283b838dbc4b4010: Field upgrade pro is now available. You can now equip 2 field upgrades instead of 1. Choose between them on each activation.

hash_68a488ee01aa2ba5: Gunsmith is a deep weapon customization system that allows you to create your own custom firearms.
hash_68a485ee01aa268c: Leveling up your weapons in battle will unlock new attachments across 8 attachment zones, as well as weapon perks.
hash_68a486ee01aa283f: Upgrade your weapon with up to 5 attachments that significantly change how your weapon feels. Experiment with various combinations to suit your playstyle and different game modes.
hash_7427fb261d136caa: When selecting attachments, hit the Blueprint button to select from the attachment variants you own!
hash_7427fa261d136af7: Combine cosmetic attachment variants from up to 5 weapons to create the weapon that's right for you!
hash_486d28a9225c0244: New Intel Missions are available to play in Warzone. Find more information in the Missions menu on the Intel tab.
hash_486d2ba9225c075d: Intel Missions give you a variety of scavenger based missions to do when dropping into the Warzone.
hash_486d2aa9225c05aa: Completing the Intel Missions will give you the chance to follow Ghost and learn more about Verdansk.
hash_2ef150e3933a297a: Killstreaks are powerful support packages that you can call into the battlefield during a match. Used properly, they can turn the tide of a fight.
hash_2ef14fe3933a27c7: Earn Killstreaks by getting Kills without dying. Each type of Killstreak requires a specific number of Kills to earn. The more Kills one costs, the more powerful it is. You may choose three Killstreaks as part of your combat readiness.
hash_2ef14ee3933a2614: When you're in combat, you may trigger each Killstreak once you've achieved the corresponding number of Kills. Be sure to keep an eye on the Killstreak HUD to see what you have available.

hash_3bb6869e4621245: Primary and Secondary weapons form the base of your class. Perks give your soldier special abilities on the battlefield, while Munitions and Roles allow you provide support to your team.
hash_49fb75b3fda10c12: You may create and name multiple loadouts for various gameplay situations. Be sure to experiment with new combinations as you level up and unlock new functionality. You can set your favorite loadout to see it on the gun bench and in the hands of your Operator in the menus.

hash_53bca32596fd4464: Missions must be activated in order to complete them. Activate a Mission from the Missions page and track your progress. You will be notified when you complete each step and when you have completed your overall objectives.

hash_3718493cde07331: Create a Custom Mod in Gunsmith by adding attachments, customizing with camos and charms, and then saving it into one of your Mod Slots. You can personalize its name to make it stand out.

options/activate_super_desc: Press to use your Field Upgrade.
options/adapter_desc:
Choose ^%which display adapter to use.^7 Display Adapter is also known as "Graphics Card" or "Video Card".

Note: Restarting the game is required for changes to take effect.
options/ads_mouse_sens_multi_disabled_de: ^3ADS Sensitivity Multiplier^/ is locked because the ^3Custom Sensitivity Per Zoom^/ is set to ^3On^/.^7
options/ads_mouse_sensitivity_desc:
Defines which algorithm is used for the mouse sensitivity when ^%Aiming Down Sights^7.

^%Legacy:^7 When Aiming Down Sights, your rotation speed is reduced based on your new field of view. This is how it worked in previous titles.

^%Relative:^7 Like Legacy, but your rotation speed is adjusted to travel a specific monitor distance with the same mouse movement, no matter your zoom level. This distance can be adjusted with the ^%Monitor Distance Coefficient^7 setting.
options/ads_sensitivity_multiplier_2x_de:
Further customize the mouse sensitivity while ^%Aiming Down Sights^7. Only applies to ^%2x and 3x^7 magnification levels.

This will also affect the magnification of the ^%Gunship AGM-114 ammunition^7 and ^%mounted machine guns^7. 

Note: Setting this value to 1.00 will keep the default ADS sensitivity.
options/ads_sensitivity_multiplier_4x_de:
Further customize the mouse sensitivity while ^%Aiming Down Sights^7. Only applies to ^%4x and 5x^7 magnification levels.

This will also affect the magnification of the ^%Chopper Gunner^7.

Note: Setting this value to 1.00 will keep the default ADS sensitivity.
options/ads_sensitivity_multiplier_6x_de:
Further customize the mouse sensitivity while ^%Aiming Down Sights^7. Only applies to ^%6x and 7x^7 magnification levels.

Note: Setting this value to 1.00 will keep the default ADS sensitivity.
options/ads_sensitivity_multiplier_8x_de:
Further customize the mouse sensitivity while ^%Aiming Down Sights^7. Only applies to ^%8x and 9x^7 magnification levels.

This will also affect the magnification of the ^%Gunship 40mm ammunition^7.

Note: Setting this value to 1.00 will keep the default ADS sensitivity.
options/ads_sensitivity_multiplier_desc:
Customize the mouse sensitivity while ^%Aiming Down Sights^7.

Note: Setting this value to 1.00 will keep the default ADS sensitivity.
options/ads_sensitivity_multiplier_highz:
Further customize the mouse sensitivity while ^%Aiming Down Sights^7. Only applies to high magnification levels (^%10x or more^7).

This will also affect the magnification of the ^%Gunship 25mm ammunition^7.

Note: Setting this value to 1.00 will keep the default ADS sensitivity.
options/ads_sensitivity_multiplier_hold_:
Further customize the mouse sensitivity while ^%Aiming Down Sights^7. Only applies while ^%focusing^7 to steady your aim.

This value is applied to your base ^%ADS Sensitivity Multiplier^7. 

Note: Setting this value to 1.00 will keep the default ADS sensitivity.
options/ads_sensitivity_multiplier_lowzo:
Further customize the mouse sensitivity while ^%Aiming Down Sights^7. Only applies to low magnification levels (^%less than 2x^7) including iron sights.

Note: Setting this value to 1.00 will keep the default ADS sensitivity.
